set.body:
Why: the enum admits ReducedRankRegression(YToX, ...) but the plan executor rejects it with UnsupportedEstimator (Plans.scala:370-371). The type is wider than the implementation, and the enum is a tag that does not drive dispatch (each method is a bespoke object in Decompositions.scala).

Scope: either remove YToX until it is implemented, or implement it; and make computation dispatch on the enum rather than bespoke objects (converges with the keystone item).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] No value constructible from PairedLatentMethod yields UnsupportedEstimator — every representable case is fit-able, or the unsupported case is removed from the type.
- [ ] A test enumerates all PairedLatentMethod cases and fits each successfully.
- [ ] JVM+JS green.
set.title: multivar: narrow PairedLatentMethod so it cannot represent unsupported states
